content:
**Home Defense** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased turret damage. The perk also allows the player to safely disarm traps found in the world without triggering them.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Workshop turrets do +100% damage and you can disarm expert traps. | 003896F8 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Workshop turrets do +75% damage and you can disarm advanced traps. | 003896F7 | 
| ★ | 1 | Workshop turrets do +50% damage and you can disarm better traps. | 003896F6 |
